name: Gluten
overview: Scripture addresses the issue of gluttony as a spiritual and moral concern, warning that excessive indulgence leads to poverty, shame, and destruction, as seen in Proverbs and Philippians. The Bible contrasts wise moderation, such as eating only what is sufficient, with the folly of being controlled by earthly desires, including the appetite. Jesus Himself faced accusations of gluttony, highlighting the tension between physical needs and spiritual priorities. Ultimately, the call is to seek daily provision from God and to live in obedience rather than being enslaved to the cravings of the flesh.
